verdict.credibility_line: Growth promises are delivered, while capex and some margin items remain imprecisely checkable or exceed guides.

promises.promise: May 2026: revenue growth at 1.5x market growth rate.
promises.delivered: Sep 2026 revenue grew 53% YoY, above implied 18% growth if market grew 12%.

promises.promise: May 2026: 12%-14% EBITDA margin near-mid term; 11%-13% long term Cables & Wires.
promises.delivered: Sep 2026 EBITDA margin was 14.4%, inside near-mid term 12%-14% guide.

promises.promise: Oct 2025: invest ₹12-16 billion annually through FY 2030.
promises.delivered: FY2026 investing cash outflow was ₹2,850 cr, not within ~15% of ₹1,200-₹1,600 cr guide.

promises.promise: May 2026: cumulative capex of INR 6,000-8,000 crores by FY2030.
promises.delivered: Not reportable until Mar 2030 year (FY2030). FY2030 window has not ended, so annual cumulative capex promise cannot be checked yet.

promises.promise: Jan 2026: FMEG segment EBITDA margins 8%-10% by FY30.
promises.delivered: FMEG annual EBITDA margin by FY2030 is not in provided company-level financials.

guidance_now: Jul 2026 call: Wires & Cables EBIT margin target of 11%-13% under Project Spring.
May 2026 call: mid-term 12%-14% EBITDA margin, long-term 11%-13% EBITDA margin.
Oct 2025 call: FY2026 H2 EBITDA margin of 15.2% and PAT margin of 10.4%.
bull: Dec 2025 revenue of ₹7,636 cr met the guided 46% year-on-year growth.
May 2026 mid-term EBITDA margin guide was respected: Sep 2026 margin was 14.4%.
FY2026 revenue grew 29% and PAT grew 32%, supporting confident tone.
bear: Dec 2025 revenue matched 46% growth, but EBITDA margin slipped from 15.8% to 12.7%.
FY2026 investing cash outflow was ₹2,850 cr, far above the ₹1,200-₹1,600 cr annual guide.
Jan 2026 FMEG segment margin path cannot be checked from provided company-level financials.
questions: How reliable is the FY2030 EHV revenue claim if EPC timing already cuts Q1 FY27 revenue 11%?
Can the 1.5x market growth translate into orders without adding capex above the implied ₹12-16bn annual path?
